settings.title: uta! settings
settings.lyrics.position.label: Lyrics position
settings.lyrics.position.description: Place lyrics at the top, centre or bottom of the playfield.
settings.lyrics.position.disabled: Lyrics are hidden by the selected mod.
settings.lyrics.size.label: Lyrics size
settings.lyrics.size.description: Scale the current line, reading text and upcoming line together.
settings.lyrics.size.disabled: Lyrics are hidden by the selected mod.
settings.lyrics.typeface.label: Lyrics font
settings.lyrics.typeface.description: Choose a bundled lazer typeface. Missing glyphs always use framework fallback fonts.
settings.lyrics.typeface.disabled: Lyrics are hidden by the selected mod.
settings.pitch.curves.label: Pitch curves
settings.pitch.curves.description: Show the song reference, detected voice, both curves, or neither.
settings.pitch.curves.disabled: The pitch guide is hidden by the selected mod.
settings.pitch.guide_trail.label: Singing guide trail
settings.pitch.guide_trail.description: Show a thicker glowing trail behind the detected voice.
settings.pitch.guide_trail.disabled: The pitch guide is hidden or reduced motion is active.
settings.hud.score_position.label: Score HUD position
settings.hud.score_position.description: Choose the corner used by the live score panel.
settings.hud.scale.label: HUD scale
settings.hud.scale.description: Scale uta!-specific gameplay panels without changing the global lazer HUD.
settings.video.visibility.label: Video visibility
settings.video.visibility.description: Automatically follow package video availability, always show it, or keep it hidden.
settings.video.visibility.disabled: This song has no video asset.
settings.video.dim.label: Video dim
settings.video.dim.description: Darken the video behind pitch, lyrics and scoring elements.
settings.video.blur.label: Video blur
settings.video.blur.description: Blur the gameplay video to reduce visual competition.
settings.video.blur.disabled: Video is hidden, unavailable, or hardware blur is unsupported.
settings.video.offset.label: Video offset
settings.video.offset.description: Positive values seek further into the video at the same song time.
settings.video.offset.disabled: This song has no video asset.
settings.video.fit_mode.label: Video fit
settings.video.fit_mode.description: Crop to fill the screen or contain the whole frame.
settings.video.fit_mode.disabled: This song has no video asset.
settings.video.controls.label: Practice video controls
settings.video.controls.description: Show video-aware pause, seek and restart actions. They always control the gameplay clock, never the decoder alone.
settings.visual.animation_intensity.desc: Scale pulses, glows and movement requested by the selected skin.
settings.visual.animation_intensity.disa: Reduced motion forces a safe minimal value.
settings.visual.singing_particles.label: Singing particles
settings.visual.singing_particles.descri: Emit lightweight particles while a confident voice is detected.
settings.visual.singing_particles.disabl: Reduced motion is active or the skin explicitly disables this optional layer.
settings.visual.scoring_particles.label: Scoring particles
settings.visual.scoring_particles.descri: Emit a short, grade-coded burst when a note is completed.
settings.visual.scoring_particles.disabl: Reduced motion is active or scoring is disabled.
settings.visual.particle_density.label: Particle density
settings.visual.particle_density.descrip: Limit the number of simultaneous optional particles.
settings.audio.bgm_output.label: BGM output
settings.audio.bgm_output.description: Hardware output used by the instrumental track.
settings.audio.bgm_output.disabled: No audio output devices are available.
settings.audio.vocals_output.label: Vocals output
settings.audio.vocals_output.description: Hardware output used by original or guide vocals.
settings.audio.vocals_output.disabled: No separate vocal asset is available.
settings.audio.bgm_volume.label: Background music
settings.audio.bgm_volume.description: Volume of the instrumental track during uta! gameplay.
settings.audio.vocals_volume.label: Original vocals
settings.audio.vocals_volume.description: Volume of the independently routed vocal track.
settings.audio.vocals_volume.disabled: No separate vocal asset is available.
settings.microphone.device.label: Microphone
settings.microphone.device.description: Input device used for live pitch detection.
settings.microphone.device.disabled: Auto play is active and does not use the microphone.
settings.microphone.monitor_output.label: Microphone monitor output
settings.microphone.monitor_output.descr: Hardware output used for live microphone monitoring.
settings.microphone.input_gain.label: Microphone input gain
settings.microphone.input_gain.descripti: Software gain applied before pitch detection and monitoring.
settings.microphone.input_gain.disabled: Auto play is active and does not use the microphone.
settings.microphone.monitor_volume.label: Microphone monitor
settings.microphone.monitor_volume.descr: Hear your microphone through the active output. Headphones are recommended.
settings.microphone.monitor_volume.disab: Auto play is active or no microphone is available.
settings.microphone.latency.label: Microphone latency
settings.microphone.latency.description: Positive values compare detected voice with an earlier point in the song.
settings.microphone.latency.disabled: Auto play is active and uses song-time reference data.
settings.microphone.sampling.label: Pitch sampling interval
settings.microphone.sampling.description: Lower values update faster but use more CPU.
settings.microphone.sampling.disabled: Auto play is active and uses deterministic 20 ms scoring bins.
settings.microphone.auto_measure.label: Auto-measure microphone latency
settings.microphone.auto_measure.descrip: Measure the microphone route and write the suggested latency value.
settings.microphone.auto_measure.disable: Auto play is active or microphone input could not be initialised.
settings.practice.default_speed.label: Default practice speed
settings.practice.default_speed.descript: Starting speed used by the Practice HUD; it remains adjustable during play.
settings.practice.loop_lead_in.label: Phrase loop lead-in
settings.practice.loop_lead_in.descripti: Preparation time before a looped phrase starts again.
settings.practice.show_controls.label: Show Practice HUD
settings.practice.show_controls.descript: Show loop, phrase navigation and live speed controls.
settings.controls.controller_hints.label: Controller hints
settings.controls.controller_hints.descr: Show the currently available controller shortcuts beside actions.
settings.accessibility.reduced_motion.de: Disable particles, large pulses and continuous decorative motion.
settings.accessibility.high_contrast_out: Keep a neutral outline around target notes, live pitch and playhead even when a skin uses low-contrast colours.
This safety layer cannot be fully disabled for critical gameplay cues.
settings.accessibility.large_touch_targe: Use at least 56 px controls in narrow-window and touch layouts.
settings.accessibility.always_show_label: Pair icons with text in settings and gameplay controls.
settings.diagnostics.debug_logging.label: Debug performance logging
settings.diagnostics.debug_logging.descr: Write frame, memory, microphone, curve and synchronisation metrics to the runtime log.
settings.diagnostics.import_history.desc: Review sanitised errors and warnings from recent .utz imports.
settings.diagnostics.import_history.disa: No import diagnostics are available yet.
settings.storage.performance_root.label: Performance archive folder
settings.storage.performance_root.descri: Folder used for recordings, pitch replays and performance metadata.
settings.storage.performance_root.disabl: Recording storage is unavailable on this platform.
